module_summary: FIFO pointer controller: push/pop strobes advance write (tail) and read (head) pointers and update an occupancy count by a signed delta.

anchors.name: tail
anchors.why: Write pointer, increments on push, cleared by clr.

anchors.name: head
anchors.why: Read pointer, increments on pop, cleared by clr.

anchors.name: fill
anchors.why: Occupancy count updated by +1/-1/0 delta each cycle.

anchors.name: inc
anchors.why: Push strobe: advances write pointer and contributes +1 to occupancy.

anchors.name: dec
anchors.why: Pop strobe: advances read pointer and contributes -1 to occupancy.

anchors.name: delta
anchors.why: Signed occupancy increment from push/pop combination.

groups.name: pointer_counters
groups.description: Read/write pointers and occupancy counter driven by push/pop strobes and clear.
